relationships.subject: ECN
relationships.evidence_quote: CFA administration elevated the levels of IL-1β and TNF-α in the paw tissue measured by ELISA; this effect was reversed by ECN (Fig. 7).

relationships.subject: ECN
relationships.evidence_quote: ECN reduced the expression level of these proteins compared to the CFA treated group.

relationships.subject: ECN
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemistry analysis showed a marked decrease in the expression level of p-JNK (phosphorylated C-Jun N-terminal kinase), NF-κB (Nuclear factor-kappa B), COX-2 (Cyclooxygenase-2), and TNF-α (Tumour necrosis factor-alpha) compared to the CFA-treated group.

relationships.subject: ECN
relationships.evidence_quote: ECN showed multiple hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic bonds with p65 (His 58A, Ser 112A, Thr 60A).

key_findings: ECN reduced edema, hyperalgesia and allodynia in carrageenan and CFA arthritis models and lowered TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, COX-2, p-JNK and NF-kB.
Docking/MD indicate ECN binds JNK, p65, COX-2 and TNF-alpha.
